big: Meena's buyer deducted ₹3 lakh in TDS on her flat sale. Her real tax came to ₹1.8 lakh. The extra ₹1.2 lakh sits with the tax office until she files a return and claims it.

lines: Can I get the extra TDS back?
Yes, through a return. You need a PAN. You can also apply in advance for a lower deduction certificate so the payer deducts less in the first place.

rows: Apply for a lower deduction certificate in advance
note: Rules change, so check the current rule with your bank or a qualified adviser.

q: Rohan's TDS exceeded his tax liability. How does he get the excess back?
opts: Ask the buyer to send it back
Ask a neighbour for a refund
why: The buyer already paid the tax over to the tax office.
Waiting does not by itself trigger any refund of tax.
A neighbour has no power to refund tax paid.
A return lets him claim the excess tax back as a refund.

opts: A mobile phone number of a person
A branch code of a bank
The number printed on a passport
why: It is not a mobile number, but a tax number.
It is the tax number used for most financial activity.
It is not a bank branch code, but a tax number.
It is not a passport number, but a tax number.

q: Meena wants less tax deducted on a coming sale. What can she apply for?
opts: A monthly bus pass for travel
A library membership card for books
A ration card for food items
why: A bus pass has no part in tax deduction.
A library card has no part in tax deduction.
The tax officer can allow a lower deduction in advance.
A ration card has no part in tax deduction.

q: When does an NRI generally need to file a return?
opts: On crossing the limit or for a refund
Never, since NRIs are all exempt from it
Only on a birthday in the same year
Only if a friend asks them to do so
why: Income above the limit or a refund claim needs a return.
There are cases where filing is needed, so not never.
A birthday has no link to the duty to file.
A friend's request has no link to the duty to file.

pts: File a return to claim excess TDS back.
A PAN is needed for most Indian financial activity.
A lower deduction certificate cuts TDS in advance.
